Nandish Sandhu, a television actor and former husband of actress Rashami Desai, married Kavita Banerjee in a traditional Bengali wedding in Hooghly, West Bengal. The marriage was announced by several news outlets.

The couple began multiday celebrations in Hooghly, West Bengal, which included various traditional Bengali rituals. The multiday events were held over several days.

Both Sandhu and Banerjee are known for their work in Indian television, and the wedding was reported by several news outlets including The Times of India, Moneycontrol, NewsBytes, India Today and ANI. The coverage included photographs from the ceremony.
